sections.label: The opening
sections.line: VoiceDebrief is ready to relaunch: a simpler core, agent workflows moved to the CRM, and a proper App Store launch.
sections.para: Its own name, accounts, domains and payments.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Ready for market; the core works; it grew a workbench; keep, move, add; do it properly; dream bigger.

sections.label: What VoiceDebrief already does
sections.line: Record without loss, on-device transcript and debrief, a library, vaults, sending, identity, credit.
sections.para: 35 screens tested; a web version and MeetScribe beside it.

sections.label: Why simpler
sections.line: The agent workbench moves to the CRM app; the core stays; payments, account, share sheet and iCloud are added.
sections.para: Designed for one workflow, too complex for a first product.

sections.label: What it can become
sections.line: Fifteen features: debriefs per occasion, actions out, ask all your notes, brief me before, record from anywhere.
sections.para: The whole vision for the relaunch team.

sections.label: Going to market properly
sections.line: Name and domains, its own Apple accounts, App Store payments, privacy and review, usage, launch.
sections.para: On-device processing keeps the cost of a note low.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Many features unverified on a device; payments, account and listing not built; single-run timings.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The VoiceDebrief iOS repository's reality file, credit page, review sheets and issues, and its sites.
